critical_code_review_comments: Backend swap from /webhook-test/ to /webhook/ implemented correctly on both constants. Payload structures unchanged. Auth dependency intact via Depends(get_current_user).

Optional nit: _requests.post is a sync call inside an async endpoint. It works and 15s timeout is reasonable, but for production readiness consider httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop under load. Not a bug for the current MVP.

n8n workflows are currently INACTIVE (toggled off) — n8n returns 404 with the exact hint 'The workflow must be active for a production URL to run successfully'. This is a config action outside our repo (turn on the workflows in n8n) and is NOT a code bug.
Frontend EmployeeChat correctly surfaces res.data.response.message as a toast so users see the n8n hint verbatim. Good UX for hackathon demo.
